how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-blackrock-depths-02.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:4322:obj:0: Help ⟦E1⟧ get his gear back and free his friends. Return to Marshal Maxwell if you succeed.
rows.quest:4322:details:0: We need to get out of here, ⟦1⟧. Help me get my gear back from the supply area and free my friends. If we make it out of here, you are to proceed to Morgan's Vigil and speak with Marshal Maxwell. He will give you further instruction.
rows.quest:4322:progress:0: You look exhausted, ⟦2⟧. Perhaps you should have a seat by the fire and relax.
rows.quest:4322:completion:0: Amazing, ⟦3⟧. Simply amazing. Windsor stormed through here not five minutes ago. He makes some grand claims but purports that they are supported by his evidence. He is on his way to ⟦E2⟧ now to confront Bolvar and ... Lady Prestor.
rows.quest:4003:obj:0: Slay Emperor Dagran Thaurissan and free Princess ⟦E3⟧ from his evil ⟦E4⟧. ⟦4⟧
rows.quest:4003:details:0: This ⟦E5⟧ against the Dark Iron dwarves, if successful, will send a shockwave throughout their entire kingdom.
rows.quest:4003:details:1: Princess Bronzebeard is under the control of Emperor Thaurissan. To free her, you must kill the Emperor. Be warned, your task is doubly dangerous, as Bronzebeard will attack you without question while under the control of the Emperor.
rows.quest:4341:obj:1: The King mentioned that Kharan was being held prisoner there - perhaps you should try looking for a prison.
rows.quest:4341:details:0: You have been to the smoldering ruins of Thaurissan? Did you happen to run into a pitiful lout named ⟦E8⟧? The dwarf that was supposedly watching over my baby girl!
rows.quest:4341:details:3: I have had my men turn the Steppes upside down. The only clue they have as to the whereabouts of my daughter is that she may be inside the Depths. For all I know, she could be dead!
rows.quest:4341:details:4: Kharan is supposedly being held prisoner there... find him! I want answers!
rows.quest:4342:details:0: Please, hear me out before passing judgement!⟦6⟧
rows.quest:4342:progress:0: Allow me to finish telling my story.
rows.quest:4342:completion:0: As you can see, there was nothing I could have done.
rows.quest:4361:obj:0: ⟦E9⟧ and deliver the bad news to King Magni Bronzebeard.
rows.quest:4361:details:0: You must take this information back to King Magni, ⟦7⟧. He will know what to do!⟦8⟧
rows.quest:4361:completion:0: <King Magni slams his fist down in anger.>
rows.quest:4362:obj:0: Return to Blackrock Depths and rescue Princess ⟦E3⟧ from the evil clutches of Emperor Dagran Thaurissan.⟦9⟧
rows.quest:4362:details:0: It would seem as if my old adversary, Dagran Thaurissan, has me and the kingdom of ⟦E10⟧ at his mercy.
rows.quest:4362:details:1: You may be my last hope, ⟦10⟧. You must rescue my dear daughter, Moira!
rows.quest:4362:details:2: There is only one way to make sure that the ⟦E4⟧ Thaurissan has cast on Moira is broken: Kill him.
rows.quest:4362:details:3: And ⟦11⟧, do not harm her! Remember, she is being controlled by Thaurissan! The things she may do or say are a result of Thaurissan's evil ⟦E4⟧!
rows.quest:4362:completion:0: <Princess Bronzebeard weeps over the loss of Emperor Dagran Thaurissan.>
rows.quest:4363:obj:0: ⟦E9⟧ and speak with King Magni Bronzebeard.
rows.quest:4363:details:0: Thaurissan was a great and honorable dwarf. You ruined my life and the life of my unborn child!
rows.quest:4363:details:1: B<You think that Princess Bronzebeard may still be suffering from the residual ⟦E11⟧ of the Emperor's ⟦E4⟧.>
rows.quest:4363:details:2: ⟦E9⟧ and tell my father that the heir to the Kingdom of ⟦E10⟧ will be a Dark Iron dwarf.
rows.quest:4363:details:3: Whether he approves or not, it shall be.
rows.quest:4363:completion:1: It seems that even in death, Thaurissan has won.
rows.quest:4363:completion:2: You are dismissed, ⟦12⟧. Before you leave, you may choose your reward from the royal vault.
rows.quest:4363:completion:3: B<King Bronzebeard slumps into his throne to mull over this bizarre change of events.>
rows.quest:4004:details:0: You have slain my husband, ⟦14⟧! My child will be born into this world without a father.
rows.quest:4004:details:2: I assure you, this child will be the next ruler of the kingdom of ⟦E10⟧. You and your kind shall be hunted down until the end of days for this wrongful act.
rows.quest:4004:details:3: B<You think that Princess Moira may be suffering from the residual ⟦E11⟧ of Thaurissan's ⟦E4⟧.>
rows.quest:4004:details:4: Leave me be, ⟦15⟧. I am certain your warchief will be eager to hear the results of his meddling.⟦16⟧
rows.quest:4004:completion:0: <Thrall is taken aback by the information you have presented to him.>
rows.quest:4004:completion:1: BA new ⟦E13⟧ now looms on the horizon. As Magni's years dwindle down, the way shall be opened for this unborn Dark Iron to become ruler of ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:4004:completion:2: You have accomplished what I asked of you and for that, you shall be rewarded.
rows.quest:4004:completion:3: Now leave me, ⟦17⟧! I must confer with Sylvanas and Cairne.
rows.quest:7604:obj:0: Turn the ⟦E14⟧ in to Lokhtos Darkbargainer if you would like to receive the plans for Sulfuron.
rows.quest:7604:details:0: The undersigned hereby declares that the Sulfuron ingot they are delivering to the Thorium Brotherhood (TB Ltd.) is genuine and not a facsimile thereof. The undersigned also acknowledges that any harm that should come to ⟦18⟧ as a result of attempting to build, forge, find, create, sell, or eat Sulfuras, is not the responsibility or fault of TB Ltd.
rows.quest:7604:details:1: By signing this contract, you are agreeing to all terms listed herein.
rows.quest:7604:completion:0: It has been a pleasure doing business with you, ⟦19⟧!
rows.quest:7604:completion:1: On behalf of TB Ltd., I wish you luck in your search for Sulfuras!
rows.quest:9015:obj:0: ⟦E7⟧ to the Ring of the Law in Blackrock Depths and place the ⟦E15⟧ in its center as you are sentenced by High Justice Grimstone. Slay Theldren and his gladiators and return to Anthion Harmon in the ⟦E16⟧ with the first piece of Lord Valthalak's amulet.
rows.quest:9015:details:0: Heed me well, ⟦20⟧. For the banner to work in the desired way, you will need to step into the Ring of the Law in Blackrock Depths. Allow yourself to be sentenced by High Justice Grimstone and place the banner firmly on the ground in a sign of defiance.
rows.quest:9015:details:1: Your victim will not be able to restrain himself and shall enter the fray filled with a desire to fight you. Once you obtain that which you seek, go back to Anthion.
rows.quest:9015:completion:0: You've recovered part of the medallion, ⟦22⟧?
